summary.summary: Don Etherton called Arizona Roofers asking if they can replace some “piled roof pieces” on his roof in Wickhamberg. Bronte explained that if it is just placing/replacing tiles, the scope is smaller than what their company typically takes on and recommended using a roofing repair specialist/handyman instead. She suggested searching Google using the customer’s city plus “roofing handyman specialist” to find direct contacts, noting it would likely be more time- and cost-effective and that Arizona Roofers is currently booking 4–8 weeks out. Don thanked her and ended the call without scheduling any service.
key_points: Customer (Don Etherton) requested replacement of some roof pieces/tiles on his roof in Wickhamberg.
Rep stated this type of minor tile placement/replacement is smaller than what Arizona Roofers typically takes and recommended a roofing repair specialist/handyman.
Rep advised searching Google with the city and the terms “roofing handyman specialist,” and mentioned Arizona Roofers is currently 4–8 weeks out; no appointment was booked.
action_items: Customer to search for and contact a local roofing handyman/repair specialist for the minor tile replacement.
next_steps: Customer to use Google search (city + “roofing handyman specialist”) to find direct contact cards and schedule the repair with a specialist.

pending_actions.raw_text: I recommend going on Google specifically and typing in your city and then roofing handyman specialist, all three words

issues: Did not capture or verify contact details (phone/email) or service address.
Did not ask clarifying needs-discovery questions (extent of damage, how long, roof type/material, photos/inspection) before determining it was too small of a job.
No clear next-step offered beyond generic Google search (no attempt to schedule an inspection/estimate or offer a paid repair option if available).
Did not provide a warm transfer/referral or vetted recommendation when asked; only suggested searching online.
Did not confirm understanding of the request or summarize the outcome before ending the call.
positive_behaviors: Professional greeting with company name and representative name.
Set expectations transparently about current lead time (4–8 weeks) and fit for minor repairs.
Provided an alternative path (search terms and provider types) to help the caller find a more suitable option.
Maintained a courteous, respectful tone and closed politely.
